selection: At most one timeframe per strategy and market. Exclude buy-hold benchmarks. Require positive net P&L, Sharpe >=0.25, max drawdown <=35%, >=4 of 6 positive calendar years, positive P&L after subtracting another copy of costs, and >=60 trades (30 for RSI2/daily TSMOM). Rank eligible timeframes by screening Sharpe, then net P&L, then key. No replacements after later tests.
followup: Frozen 2024 calendar-year baseline, doubled-cost and extra-bar-delay runs (delay only for signal strategies). Native 2025 evaluation calibrated on 2024; native Jan-Aug 2026 evaluation calibrated on 2025, singleton candidates. Two nearby parameter variants on 2022-2023 only, diagnostic without reselection. Trend and volatility attribution on 2026 evaluations.
followup_acceptance: Every scored baseline/cost/supported-delay scenario must have strictly positive net P&L, drawdown <=35%, and >=10 trades (5 for daily TSMOM/RSI2). Prior failure remains a failure. Nonpositive equity is infeasible under the simulator capital assumptions. Sensitivity results and ORB carry events remain separate review flags.
costs: USD 100000 per independently tested sleeve; one full-sized contract; $1.25 commission per side and 1 tick per side. Double both in stress. ORB risk cap $2500 and maximum one contract. No capital/position sizing optimization.
dates: 2010-2017 data provides warmup but is not a scored campaign period. September 2026 is excluded because only three days are available. Prior repository history has inspected later periods: chronological historical validation, not certified untouched evidence.
sources: All current nine adapters across all four registered charts and every declared supported timeframe. Original unported sources are inventoried separately; their unavailable rules are not represented as backtested.
caveats: Unadjusted volume-rolled continuous futures; roll gaps can affect P&L.
ORB known missing-window overnight carry issue remains unchanged and will be audited.
Fixed contract risk differs across markets; do not compare dollar profit as equal risk.
104 initial combinations plus declared later diagnostics are a multiple-testing search, not independent discoveries.
